what.zh: trtllm-serve 没有服务名参数，模型以其路径对外；这个名字只用于平台的实例标签和统计。
what.en: trtllm-serve has no served-name option and lists the model by its path; this name is used only for the platform's instance labels and statistics.

what.zh: 写入 extra_llm_api_options 文件的 kv_cache_config.dtype。
what.en: Written to kv_cache_config.dtype in the extra_llm_api_options file.

label.zh: KV 缓存比例（权重之外的空闲显存）
label.en: KV cache fraction (of memory left after weights)

summary.zh: TensorRT-LLM 把加载权重后剩余显存的这个比例分给 KV 缓存。
summary.en: TensorRT-LLM gives this fraction of the memory left after the weights to the KV cache.

what.zh: 对应 --kv_cache_free_gpu_memory_fraction。它是权重加载后空闲显存的比例。
what.en: Maps to --kv_cache_free_gpu_memory_fraction. It is a fraction of the memory free after the weights load.

whenToChange.zh: 启动时报显存不足就调小；同卡还有其它程序时也应调小。
whenToChange.en: Lower it when the start runs out of memory, or when other programs share the GPU.

tradeoffs.zh: 过高会让激活没有余量；过低则 KV 缓存变小，长上下文并发会排队。
tradeoffs.en: Too high leaves no room for activations; too low shrinks the KV cache and queues long concurrent requests.

what.zh: 对应 --reasoning_parser，填 trtllm-serve 认识的解析器名称，例如 qwen3、deepseek-r1。
what.en: Maps to --reasoning_parser; give a parser name trtllm-serve knows, for example qwen3 or deepseek-r1.

whenToChange.zh: 客户端看不到思考内容或工具调用时。
whenToChange.en: When clients do not see the thinking or the tool calls.

tradeoffs.zh: 名称必须是 trtllm-serve 认识的解析器；留空表示不解析。
tradeoffs.en: The name must be a parser trtllm-serve knows; leave it empty to parse nothing.

what.zh: 对应 --tool_parser，填 trtllm-serve 认识的解析器名称，例如 qwen3。
what.en: Maps to --tool_parser; give a parser name trtllm-serve knows, for example qwen3.

whenToChange.zh: 客户端看不到思考内容或工具调用时。
whenToChange.en: When clients do not see the thinking or the tool calls.

tradeoffs.zh: 名称必须是 trtllm-serve 认识的解析器；留空表示不解析。
tradeoffs.en: The name must be a parser trtllm-serve knows; leave it empty to parse nothing.
